focus_areas: Legibility and semantic validity of screen text

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI-generated images of screens, fake text is a common failure mode. Even if the classifier identifies the object as a 'hand-held computer', the presence of nonsensical text significantly degrades the realism and functional plausibility of the image. Also, evaluate if the yellow device is a coherent object or a hallucinated amalgamation of features.

To rigorously analyze the gibberish text on the screen and confirm it is not valid UI text.
To check for fusion or boundary bleeding between the keys and the body of the device.
